paragraphs.en: This is Dilnoza. She is eleven years old. Her family is new in Namangan. Today is her first day at a new school, and she is very nervous.
paragraphs.uz: Bu Dilnoza. U o'n bir yoshda. Uning oilasi Namanganga yangi ko'chib kelgan. Bugun uning yangi maktabdagi birinchi kuni va u juda hayajonda.

paragraphs.en: Her classroom is big and bright. There are twenty-five students in the class. The teacher's name is Mrs Karimova. She is tall and she has a kind smile.
paragraphs.uz: Uning sinfi katta va yorug'. Sinfda yigirma besh nafar o'quvchi bor. O'qituvchining ismi Karimova opa. U baland bo'yli va mehribon tabassumi bor.

paragraphs.en: "Class, this is Dilnoza," says Mrs Karimova. "Please sit next to Zarina." Zarina is a girl with long black hair. She says, "Hi! Do you like English?"
paragraphs.uz: "Bolalar, bu Dilnoza," deydi Karimova opa. "Iltimos, Zarinaning yoniga o'tir." Zarina — uzun qora sochli qiz. U: "Salom! Ingliz tilini yaxshi ko'rasanmi?" deydi.

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I love English!" says Dilnoza. "Me too!" says Zarina. At lunch, they eat together. Zarina has some apples and Dilnoza has some bread and cheese. They share their food.
paragraphs.uz: "Ha, ingliz tilini juda yaxshi ko'raman!" deydi Dilnoza. "Men ham!" deydi Zarina. Tushlikda ular birga ovqatlanishadi. Zarinada bir nechta olma, Dilnozada esa non va pishloq bor. Ular ovqatlarini baham ko'rishadi.

paragraphs.en: After school, Dilnoza's mother asks, "How is your new school?" Dilnoza smiles. "It's great, Mum. I have a new friend!"
paragraphs.uz: Maktabdan keyin Dilnozaning onasi: "Yangi maktabing qanday?" deb so'raydi. Dilnoza jilmayadi. "Zo'r, oyi. Yangi dugonam bor!"
